tasks.label: Install Python Dependencies
tasks.command: source .venv/bin/activate && pip3 install $(python3 -c "import tomllib, shlex; deps = tomllib.load(open('${workspaceFolder}/pyproject.toml', 'rb'))['project']['dependencies']; print(' '.join(shlex.quote(d) for d in deps))")
tasks.detail: Installs Python packages declared in pyproject.toml
